blocks.text: 1 Samuel 21 contains 15 verses. It opens with: Then came David to Nob to Ahimelech the priest: and Ahimelech came to meet David trembling, and said unto him, Why art thou alone, and no man with thee? It concludes with: Do I lack madmen, that ye have brought this fellow to play the madman in my presence? shall this fellow come into my house? Supplied contextual evidence for this passage adds: First Samuel moves from Eli's failing priestly house through Samuel's prophetic leadership and Saul's rejected kingship to David's anointing, rise, exile, and Saul's death.
